name: injected_paper_electricity
note: Generated in memory with Cerqueira et al.'s parameters (shuffle, one drift in 50-80%, width = delta_max = 2500, 50 trials, label_skip_proba 0.75). Scored like their code: input-row coordinates (dropped rows still count), alarms before 25% of the stream ignored, window [d_s, d_s + delta_max]. Only 'detector' presets follow their workflow (one HT never reset on alarm); pipeline presets adapt on alarms, so their F1 is reference only. Remaining differences: River instead of CapyMOA/MOA implementations, and our own random draws.

name: injected_paper_covertype
